sections.text:
BioIntel Demo
Metabolism reference page
BioIntel demonstration record 5. The compound rosiglitazone was discussed with target PPARG in the context of type 2 diabetes. The example mutation is P12A. A demonstration EC50 measurement of 390 nM is shown for Homo sapiens. Synthetic reference labels: SYN-PAPER-0005 and SYN-DOI-NOT-REAL-0005.
